# git: alias: support some merge strategies for shake command

Make `git shake` ([[DOT-33]]) recognise branches that were integrated by rebase or by squash. **Motivation:** the author merges with rebase or with rebase-and-squash, after which `git branch --merged` no longer sees the branch as merged — its commits are not ancestors of the default branch — so the cleanup skips exactly the branches that are done. The [Stack Overflow thread](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/24800387/mass-deleting-local-branches-that-has-been-rebased-and-merged) describes the `git cherry`/`merge-tree` based detection: a branch is "squash-merged" if a squashed commit of its diff is already in the base.
